data.title: Mini Program
data.tagline: A lightweight app that runs inside a host app such as WeChat
data.learningOutcome: Identify a mini program by its host environment rather than its appearance or a QR code.
data.description: A shop can share a booking mini program in a chat, letting customers choose a time inside WeChat. A browser booking page may look the same; its runtime and available capabilities differ.

learning.assumes: You have opened a booking or ordering page inside WeChat.
learning.outcome: Identify a mini program by its host environment rather than its appearance or a QR code.

distinctions.label: Mobile website
distinctions.explanation: Runs as a website in a browser. A page inside WeChat can also be a website, so the WeChat window alone is insufficient.

distinctions.label: Native app
distinctions.explanation: Installed as its own app. A mini program uses a host app and its supported components and APIs.

explanation.title: An environment for the app
explanation.text: The host loads the mini program code and provides navigation, components, and supported device capabilities.

explanation.title: Its own development rules
explanation.text: A native WeChat mini program uses WXML for structure, WXSS for styles, and JavaScript for behavior. Other platforms have their own conventions.

data.boundary: Opening the page does not prove a booking was saved. Saving records still needs a backend or cloud service, and platform permissions and release requirements must be checked separately.

lessonPractice.title: Two booking screens look alike. One opens as a WeChat mini program, the other by a browser URL. What distinguishes them?

options.label: The environment that loads and runs the screen
options.feedback: The host mini program environment and browser runtime differ even when the design matches.

options.label: Whether both screens have a booking button
options.feedback: A booking button describes a function, not the runtime.

options.label: Whether customers entered through a QR code
options.feedback: A QR code can lead to either runtime; inspect what it opens.

data.agentPrompt: Build this booking feature as a WeChat mini program, keeping time selection and booking history. Explain which website code needs adaptation before implementing. Open it in WeChat Developer Tools and verify entry, navigation, and booking persistence on a device.
